headline: Founder-led Wisconsin messaging is still the clearest growth lever, competitor search remains an expensive leak, and this week’s biggest risk is still stale reporting rather than weak demand.

items: Meta’s best hooks are still crisp and believable: 'Straight From Wisconsin' has driven 13,622 link clicks at $0.11 CPC, while 'Meet Real Dough Pizza Co.' is still one of the most efficient ads at 4.67% CTR and $0.11 CPC.

Founder/operator content still leads organic trust across platforms: Founder Pro Tips remains the strongest Instagram post and top Facebook reel, and founder-origin storytelling stays near the top of Instagram engagement.

Brand demand is real when intent is high: Google branded search is still the cleanest pocket at 5.68% CTR and $0.21 CPC, and Instagram has grown to 623 followers with 1,269 website clicks in the current YTD window.
The June 5 Whatagraph pull worked, but the trusted Meta/Google/Facebook/Instagram reporting window still stops at 2026-05-12. This is a verification week, not a true weekly close.
Competitor Google search is still the weakest paid pocket: $1,227.77 spent at $0.59 CPC versus branded search at $0.21 CPC.

Competitive pressure is getting sharper on multiple fronts at once: Palermo/Connie’s is pushing 24-hour fermented premium pizza, Yough is scaling high-protein pizza into ~2,000 Target stores, and recall stories around Motor City show how fast retailer trust can break when operations slip.
REPORTING: Fix the Whatagraph freshness issue first so next Friday reflects a real May 13+ performance window instead of backfill noise.

PAID + CREATIVE: Keep 'Straight From Wisconsin' and founder-led ads as controls, then brief the agency to build the next batch around founder authority, fermentation/process proof, and practical dinner utility.
SEARCH: Cap or cut competitor terms unless conversion data clearly proves payback; branded and sourdough-intent traffic are materially cleaner.
BRAND/OPS: Tighten retailer-facing proof around quality, consistency, and supply-chain discipline so the sourdough story is backed by execution, not just positioning.

agency_brief.what_worked: Specific, founder-led, Wisconsin-rooted, and process-forward messaging is still outperforming generic premium language. The strongest creative combines sourdough credibility, operator voice, and an easy dinner outcome.
agency_brief.what_didnt: Competitor search remains expensive, broad premium positioning is too soft, and the current stale reporting window makes false week-over-week conclusions easy.
agency_brief.recommendation: Keep the creative system narrow and legible. Build the next round around founder education, fermentation/process proof, ingredient reassurance, and family-dinner utility. Make every ad and landing-page message answer one question fast: why is this frozen pizza worth trading up for?
agency_brief.competitive_context: The aisle is splitting between premium craft cues, functional nutrition, and operational scale. Competitors are winning with sharper claims—24-hour fermentation, high protein, cleaner labels, or retail expansion. Real Dough should defend a tighter moat around authentic sourdough craft, Wisconsin credibility, and retailer-ready execution.

missing: No usable review sentiment feed for Real Dough. data/reviews.json still contains only place-not-found errors for other MSHG brands.
No current-week Real Dough operations data. data/operations/ still contains older Merriment snapshots from March/April, not current Real Dough operating inputs.
stale: The latest trustworthy analytics view is still YTD through 2026-05-12, not a clean current-week slice.
Week-over-week Meta and Google movement is effectively frozen because the source window did not advance.
anomalies: YouTube and TikTok tabs in the current Whatagraph export are still returning sample/demo data, so current video-platform rankings remain excluded.
Small Instagram and Facebook deltas versus last week appear to be late organic backfills inside the same reporting window, not new performance.
